text:
maya (Design): Quick sync 44 prototyping a compact left nav that groups Models + Deployments. Label ideas: 'Workloads' vs 'Workspaces'?

sam (Frontend): 'Workloads' is explicit; 'Workspaces' is softer. Either's fine but breadcrumbs + routes must be consistent.

jonah (PM): Routing question: prefer canonical deep link like /workspace/:id/model/:modelId. Also support ?view=compact for share links.

sam (Frontend): Agree. Router note: fallback if modelId missing -> list; invalid workspace -> redirect to /workspace with toast. We'll accept optional ?navMode=compact for demos.

kevin (A11y): A11y nits: last breadcrumb needs aria-current; separators should be aria-hidden. Skiplink copy: "Skip to main navigation". Announce view toggles via aria-live polite ("Navigation collapsed"). Truncated crumbs should use aria-label, not title.

maya (Design): UX tweak: replace '+' with chevron and show accessible label "Expand/Collapse". Make full row clickable for 44px touch targets.

navbot (deploy-bot): branch nav-compact-experiments deployed to staging at staging.redwood.internal/nav-test (build 2026.03.22-9).

maya (Design): Action items: 1) validate skiplink target, 2) check aria-live messages, 3) confirm breadcrumb contrast, 4) test permalinks preserve view. Please try staging and drop quick reactions.

sam (Frontend): Will test and post small fixes.

jonah (PM): I'll run a hallway test and decide label by EOD Friday.

kevin (A11y): I'll upload SR pass notes later.
